description: Subcomponent for `v-audio` used to display the transport bar.

props.actions: Which built-in and custom actions to render, in order. Accepts an array or a comma/space separated string. Built-ins: `play`, `progress` (renders the seek bar inline and switches to a single row), `time`, `elapsed`, `remaining`, `volume` and `-` (a spacer). Any other name renders the `action.<name>` slot, which can also replace a built-in. `prepend` and `append` slots render at the edges unless listed.
props.actionsClass: Classes applied to the actions row.
props.color: General color applied to icons and the seek bar.
props.duration: Total duration of the audio, used to calculate the displayed time.
props.playbackRate: Current playback rate, synced with the media element. Use it with the `setPlaybackRate` slot prop to build a rate control.
props.playing: Applies the correct icon to the default play button.
props.playProps: Props passed to the default play button, e.g. `color`, `variant` or `size`.
props.progressClass: Classes applied to the progress wrapper.
props.progressVariant: Passed to the `variant` prop of the progress bar.
props.seekable: Allows seeking. When off the seek bar stays focusable but read-only.
props.seekStep: Seconds moved by the arrow keys. Holding Shift moves 10x as far, or pass `[step, shiftStep]` to set both.
props.timeDisplay: Format of the `time` action. In the stacked layout only `remaining` applies, to the time on the right.
props.volume: Volume value passed to the underlying control and slots.
props.volumeProps: Props passed down to the VMediaVolume component.
props.volumeSlider: Passed to the `slider` prop of the volume control.

events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback position changes.
events.update:volume: Emitted when the volume value changes.
events.update:playbackRate: Emitted when the playback rate changes.
events.drag:start: Emitted with the current position when the user starts dragging the progress bar.
events.drag:end: Emitted with the final position when the user stops dragging the progress bar.
events.click:stop: Emitted when `stop` is called from a slot.

slots.default: Replaces the entire contents of the control bar.
slots.prepend: Additional content on the left within the control bar.
slots.append: Additional content on the right within the control bar.
slots.play: Replaces the play button. Receives `props` to bind on your own button.
slots.progress: Replaces the seek bar. Receives `props` to bind on `v-media-progress-bar` or `v-audio-waveform`.
slots.time: Replaces the text of the `time` action. Receives the player state, formatted times are in `currentTime`.
slots.time.elapsed: Replaces the elapsed time wherever it is shown.
slots.time.remaining: Replaces the remaining time, including its minus sign, wherever it is shown.
slots.time.total: Replaces the total duration wherever it is shown.
slots.[`action.${string}`]: Renders the action of the same name listed in **actions**. Receives the player state and methods.

exposed.toggleMuted: Switches between 0 and the last non-zero volume.
